answer: Each new identity must post a refundable deposit of 12 POA into a relic pool that pays out only after a 20-epoch cooling window, and every extra account sharing a funding source or signal pattern raises the next deposit by 35 percent. A rotating committee of 7 validators sends a beacon challenge each epoch, and accounts whose reply timing correlates above 0.9 are merged into one cluster that shares a single reward slot, so a fake crowd earns nothing extra.
